name: prompt-upgrade
description: Catches vague prompts, asks one quick multiple-choice question, rewrites the prompt with a working method, and lets you review it before it runs.

mode.title: When to step in
mode.description: auto: only prompts that look vague. always: every new task you type. off: only when you run /refine <prompt>.

detector.title: Vague-prompt detector
detector.description: rules+haiku: keyword rules, and a quick Haiku check for borderline prompts. rules: keyword rules alone, so borderline prompts go through untouched.

rewriteModel.title: Rewrite model
rewriteModel.description: The model that writes the upgraded prompt. The clarifying question is always drafted by Haiku.

ui.title: Where the questions show
ui.description: panel: a side panel (falls back to a dialog if the terminal is too narrow for one). dialog: Claude Code's question dialog above the prompt.
